name: 丢丢
evolution: 丢丢 → 卡卡虫 Lv.16 → 卡瓦重 Lv.36
description: 有看到什么都会去舔一下试试看的习惯，经常忘记把舌头收回去。双眼对强光非常敏感，白天会老老实实躲在室内或者阴凉的地方。
descriptionEn: It has the habit of licking anything it sees to give it a try, and often forgets to pull its tongue back in. Its eyes are very sensitive to strong light, so during the day it stays indoors or in the shade.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%; counters an attack.
